2607.11871.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
2607.11871.paper_summary: Existing studies of LLM-as-judge scoring bias work predominantly at the input-output level: they perturb inputs, measure score deltas, and propose prompt-level mitigations. We argue that the same biases admit a representation-level account in the judge's hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways it does not afford. We report three findings, across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks. Geometry: baseline judging inputs occupy a tight activation manifold while biased inputs are displaced along a low-dimensional, type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth and is recovered consistently by three families of estimators. Causal control: steering hidden states along this subspace drives scoring in both directions, forward shifts reproducing biased scoring on clean inputs and reverse shifts restoring baseline scoring on biased ones, while matched-norm random directions produce shifts an order of magnitude smaller. Operational: a simple linear projection onto the same bias-direction features anticipates judge failures on three entirely unseen benchmarks, substantially outperforming text-based alternatives. Reading bias as activation geometry, rather than as input-output noise, unifies geometric structure, causal control, and operational prediction within a single framework. The project page is available at https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/
2607.11871.paper_summary_zh: 現有的 LLM-as-judge 評分偏差研究主要集中在輸入-輸出層面：它們擾動輸入，測量分數變化，並提出提示級別的緩解措施。我們主張，相同的偏差在評審的隱藏狀態中也可以進行表示層面的解釋，這補充了輸入-輸出觀點，並在其無法提供的方式上具有操作上的實用性。我們報告了三項發現，涵蓋七位評審、七種偏差類型和九個基準。幾何：基線評審輸入佔據了一個緊密的激活流形，而偏差輸入則在一個低維的、類型特定的子空間中偏移，這個子空間隨著深度的增加而變得更加明確，並且被三個估計器家族一致地恢復。因果控制：沿著這個子空間引導隱藏狀態會在兩個方向上驅動評分，向前的變化在乾淨的輸入上再現了偏差評分，而反向的變化則在偏差輸入上恢復了基線評分，而匹配範數的隨機方向產生的變化則小一個量級。操作性：對相同偏差方向特徵的簡單線性投影能夠預測評審在三個完全未見的基準上的失敗，並且顯著超越基於文本的替代方案。將偏差視為激活幾何，而不是輸入-輸出噪聲，將幾何結構、因果控制和操作預測統一在一個單一框架內。項目頁面可在 https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/ 獲得。
